prompt.project_info: Create a realistic calm bedroom lifestyle portrait of an original approved adult model in bright natural light.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with honey-blonde, long wavy layered hair parted in the middle, light blue-green eyes, fair complexion, soft facial features, and light pink lipstick sits on a bed looking directly at camera. She wears a white short-sleeved button-up shirt tied at the waist and blue denim jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical seated portrait with the subject centered, white bed sheets, soft pink pillows, white bedside table, small indoor plant, framed picture, and sunlight-shaped shadows on the wall. Keep the shirt knot and denim texture visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural sunlight with gentle window shadows, white, cream, soft pink, and denim-blue palette, calm aesthetic bright atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone lifestyle photography, vertical portrait framing, natural skin variation, moderate depth of field, subtle lens falloff, slightly lifted shadows, no over-processing.

White sheets, soft pink pillows, white bedside table, small plant, framed picture, and sunlight shadows on the wall create a calm bright setting. Natural smartphone photography, soft cream and pink palette, realistic texture.
